arxiv-1907-09558.title: System-Level Development of a User-Integrated Semi-Autonomous Lawn Mowing System: Problem Overview, Basic Requirements, and Proposed Architecture
arxiv-1907-09558.creator: Albert E. Patterson, Yang Yuan, William R. Norris
arxiv-1907-09558.description: Abstract This concept paper outlines some recent efforts toward the design and development of user-integrated semi-autonomous home-sized lawn mowing systems from a systems engineering perspective. This is an important and emerging field of study within the robotics and systems engineering communities.

arxiv-1912-10460.title: Quantum gravitational wave function for the interior of a black hole and the generalized uncertainty principle
arxiv-1912-10460.creator: Dong-han Yeom
arxiv-1912-10460.description: Abstract We investigate the internal structures of a Schwarzschild black hole by solving the Wheeler-DeWitt equation. The generic bounded wave function has a bouncing point around r ≃ M r\simeq M , where M M is the black hole mass. Due to this quantum bouncing, there appears an ambiguity to define the arrow of time.

arxiv-2106-06010.title: Machine Learning Framework for Sensing and Modeling Interference in IoT Frequency Bands Thanks: B. Al Homssi, A. Al-Hourani, and W. S. T. Rowe are with the School of Engineering, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia. Z. Krusevac is with the Australian Communication and Media Authority. E-mail: bhom
arxiv-2106-06010.creator: Bassel Al Homssi, Akram Al-Hourani
arxiv-2106-06010.description: Abstract Spectrum scarcity has surfaced as a prominent concern in wireless radio communications with the emergence of new technologies over the past few years. As a result, there is growing need for better understanding of the spectrum occupancy with newly emerging access technologies supporting the Internet of Things.

arxiv-2212-12763.title: On Lagrangian Coherent Structures in Laparoscopy
arxiv-2212-12763.creator: Sandeep Kumar, Caroline Crowley, Mohammad Faraz Khan, Miguel D. Bustamante, Ronan Cahill, Kevin Nolan
arxiv-2212-12763.description: Abstract . Laparoscopy is an electrosurgical medical operation often involving an application of high-frequency alternating current to remove undesired biological tissue from the insufflated abdomen accessible through inlet and outlets trocars. One of the main byproducts in this process are the gaseous particles, called surgical smoke, which is found hazardous for both the patient and the operating room staff.

arxiv-2409-14705.title: Target-Aware Language Modeling via Granular Data Sampling
arxiv-2409-14705.creator: Ernie Chang Pin-Jie Lin Yang Li Changsheng Zhao, Daeil Kim Rastislav Rabatin Zechun Liu Yangyang Shi Vikas Chandra
arxiv-2409-14705.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ernie Chang Pin-Jie Lin Yang Li Changsheng Zhao, Daeil Kim Rastislav Rabatin Zechun Liu Yangyang Shi Vikas Chandra. Language model pretraining generally targets a broad range of use cases and incorporates data from diverse sources. However, there are instances where we desire a model that excels in specific areas without markedly compromising performance in other areas. A cost-effective and straightforward approach is sampling with low-dimensional data features, which allows to select large-scale pretraining data for domain-specific use cases.

arxiv-2507-13754.title: GPU Accelerated Transducer-Field Calculation using the Traditional Born Series Formulation for Realistic Media
arxiv-2507-13754.creator: Ujjal Mandal, Jagpreet Singh, Ben T Cox, Ratan K Saha
arxiv-2507-13754.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ujjal Mandal, Jagpreet Singh, Ben T Cox, Ratan K Saha. This study numerically solves inhomogeneous Helmholtz equations modeling acoustic wave propagation in homogeneous and lossless, absorbing and dispersive, inhomogeneous and nonlinear media. The traditional Born series (TBS) method has been employed to solve such equations. The full wave solution in this methodology is expressed as an infinite sum of the solution of the unperturbed equation weighted by increasing power of the potential.

britannica-1911-nord.title: Nord (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-nord.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-nord.description: Article 'Nord' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 19), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In agricultural and industrial importance Nord is the first of French departments. In the hilly region of the south-east stock-raising flourishes; in the central zone beetroot is the characteristic crop, while mixed farming prevails in the north-west. Cereals (especially wheat and oats) and potatoes are grown in abundance. Among minor crops, flax, tobacco, chicory and hops may be mentioned.

pmc-10597193.title: Low-cost IoT sensors reveal adverse health outcomes associated with air pollution exposure
pmc-10597193.creator: S Salim, G Diallo, P Morita
pmc-10597193.description: BackgroundAir pollution is a major public health threat and has been linked to various adverse health effects including respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and coarse particulate matter (PM10) are two major components of air pollution that are significant contributors to these health outcomes.

pmc-10643984.title: A novel sophorolipids extraction method by yeast fermentation process for enhanced skin efficacy
pmc-10643984.creator: Yae‐rin Lee, Youn Jeong Cha, Sugyeong Jeong, Seok‐Kyun Yun, Younhwa Nho, Seunghyun Kang, Woonha Kim, Juhyun Son, Juyun Kim, Seoyeon Kyung
pmc-10643984.description: AimsOriental herbs have been used as medicines in the folk remedy for their numerous phytochemicals and bioactivities. In this study, we have selected five Korean traditional medical herbs and applied bio conversion extraction technology, named it as Bioconversion Oji complex, to identify phytochemicals and evaluate skin related efficacies.Material and methodsThe process of two‐step bio conversion was sequentially conducted.

pmc-10747019.title: An Indoor Fire Detection Method Based on Multi-Sensor Fusion and a Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network
pmc-10747019.creator: Xinwei Deng, Xuewei Shi, Haosen Wang, Qianli Wang, Jun Bao, Zhuming Chen, Andrea Cataldo
pmc-10747019.description: Indoor fires pose significant threats in terms of casualties and economic losses globally. Thus, it is vital to accurately detect indoor fires at an early stage. To improve the accuracy of indoor fire detection for the resource-constrained embedded platform, an indoor fire detection method based on multi-sensor fusion and a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed.

pmc-11449439.title: Light sensitivity of the circadian system in the social Highveld mole-rat Cryptomys hottentotus pretoriae
pmc-11449439.creator: Pauline N C Chanel, Nigel C Bennett, Maria K Oosthuizen
pmc-11449439.description: Highveld mole-rats (Cryptomys hottentotus pretoriae) are social rodents that inhabit networks of subterranean tunnels. In their natural environment, they are rarely exposed to light, and consequently their visual systems have regressed over evolutionary time. However, in the laboratory they display nocturnal activity, suggesting that they are sensitive to changes in ambient illumination.

pmc-11712405.title: The impact of the 6‐month adapted Otago Exercise Program on clinical measures of physical function relative to usual care alone in people living with dementia in residential care facilities: A pilot randomized controlled trial
pmc-11712405.creator: Melanie T Jones, Yanbin Dong, Haidong Zhu, Andre Soares, Charmi Patel, Colleen Hergott, Jennifer L Waller, Lufei Young, Dawnchelle Robinson‐Johnson, Richard Sams, Mark Hamrick, Deborah A Jehu
pmc-11712405.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDementia compromises physical function, posing risks for falls. People living with dementia (PWD) have been historically excluded from intervention trials due to researchers’ eligibility criteria. Exercise shows potential in enhancing physical function, but more evidence is needed.

pmc-12967480.title: Insomnia‐Driven Hippocampal Atrophy: Evidence From Bidirectional Mendelian Randomization
pmc-12967480.creator: Dandan Han, Xiang Li, Shaohua Zhao, Jiayin Liu, Xiaojiang Wang, Yu Jiang, Junrong Ding, Baojing Wang, Erfeng Cui, Ding Huang
pmc-12967480.description: BackgroundObservational studies link insomnia to hippocampal atrophy, yet causal inference remains limited by confounding and reverse causality. While Mendelian randomization (MR) studies have explored sleep‐brain associations, bidirectional causality between insomnia and hippocampal subfield volumes remains unaddressed.MethodsWe conducted bidirectional two‐sample MR using genome‐wide association study (GWAS) summary data.

pmc-13089129.title: Impacts of Multidisciplinary Lung Cancer Meeting Presentation in a Clinical Quality Registry
pmc-13089129.creator: Rob G. Stirling, Sanuki Tissera, Jessie Zeng, Mike Lloyd, Krupa Krishnaprasad, Lisa Briggs, Jacqueline Lesage, Tom Wood, Craig Underhill, Sagun Parakh, Louis Irving, Wasek Faisal, Robert Blum, Gary Richardson, Phillip Parente, Michelle Caldecott, Inger Olesen, Javier Torres, Evangeline Samuel, Chris
pmc-13089129.description: BackgroundLung cancer is a heterogeneous and complex disease requiring multidisciplinary input for optimal management planning, with guidelines recommending that all patients be discussed in a multidisciplinary setting. Multidisciplinary meeting (MDM) discussion aims to enhance evidence-based management, improve treatment access, and optimize complex management plans.

pmc-13434514.title: Linking pediatric obesity to youth-onset type 2 diabetes: integrated longitudinal and cross-sectional evidence from population-based studies worldwide
pmc-13434514.creator: Ashraf T Soliman, Fawzia Alyafei, Nada Alaaraj, Noor Hamed, Shayma Mohamed, Ahmed Elawwa
pmc-13434514.description: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a rapidly growing pediatric metabolic disorder that parallels the global childhood obesity epidemic. Despite multiple population-based registries and a global meta-analysis documenting near-universal obesity at the time of a T2DM diagnosis, no integrated synthesis spanning 25 years and including diverse populations has been performed.

pmc-13582660.title: PBMC-derive eNK cells was armed and promoted CAR-like response against tumors through armed with 16Fc21, a novel bispecific fusion protein for NK cells
pmc-13582660.creator: Yangyang Li, Yehai Wang, Ximeng Zhang, Yan Fan, Lina Pan, Jing Wu, Weihua Xiao
pmc-13582660.description: IntroductionCell-based immunotherapies of PBMC-derive Natural killer (NK) cells have demonstrated substantial potential for the treatment of hematologic malignancies. However, its application is limited due to the complex and inefficient gene modification in vitro and the insufficient therapeutic efficacy against solid tumors in vivo.
